messages:
mona: Heads-up — discovered a config edge causing 5xx for long prompt sessions in prod. Need an expedited patch during tonight's change window.
deploybot: automated triage: suspected delta image v3.2.1-rc4 -> candidate artifact: gcr.io/redwood/serve:v3.2.1-hotfix-2026-03-23. CI: unit+smoke passed, integration timed out on embed service.
sam_k: can we scope so only EU1 and eu-west1 traffic hits the patch first?
mona: plan: apply to eu1-dedicated pool first (low traffic between 02:00-03:00 UTC), then EU canary, then global if green.
ops_oncall_jay: change window ok for me 02:00-03:00 UTC, but need rollback criteria spelled out.
elaine_pm: customer-facing incidents: 1 active ticket but low priority. Approve expedited deploy if rollback is <10min.
devex_lead: quick checklist attached: 
```
- image: gcr.io/redwood/serve:v3.2.1-hotfix-2026-03-23
- config: disable prefix_cache for long prompts (temp)
- k8s: rolloutStrategy: Canary 10% -> 50% -> 100%
- monitor: latency P95, 5xx, kvcache-miss-rate
- auto-rollback hook: on 5xx >1% for 2m
```
sre_maria: +1 to hook. I will watch telemetry and cut if any regression.
sam_k: +1 if canary pinned to eu1 and we have a manual hold between stages. Also post release notes link.
mona: release notes draft: https://releases.redwood.com/notes/3.2.1-hotfix (internal) — includes mitigation steps and rollback commands.
deploybot: deploy plan created. Pipeline: preflight -> canary-rollout eu1 (10%) -> pause -> smoke tests -> 50% -> pause -> 100%. Manual approvals at each pause.
ops_oncall_jay: approval: I give green to start preflight at 01:55 UTC (quick dry-run). Will be @ops_oncall_jay in thread during window.
elaine_pm: product approves expedited path. Notifying support to prep external comms.
sam_k: tagging rollout pin: deploybot pin v=3.2.1-hotfix-2026-03-23 to eu1. If failure, rollback tag: v=3.2.0-hotfix-rollback.
mona: note for on-call: rollback command if needed: `kubectl set image deploy/serve gcr.io/redwood/serve:v3.2.0-hotfix-rollback --namespace=prod` and `./scripts/cut-traffic --region=eu1 --percent=0`.
sre_maria: I'll create a grafana dashboard panel and an alert: 5xx_rate > 0.8% sustained for 3m -> page.
deploybot: preflight started 01:55:12 UTC; logs: preflight OK, smoke harness ready.
ops_oncall_jay: kicking off canary now. I'm watching traces.
mona: +1 to proceed.
sam_k: smoke looks OK on eu1 canary (no 5xx, p95 latency unchanged). :thumbsup:
sre_maria: canary at 10% for 6m, no regressions. Hold for 2m then proceed.
deploybot: advancing to 50% at 02:10:03 UTC — pause engaged.
ops_oncall_jay: second hold complete. All monitors green. Proceed to 100%.
deploybot: rollout to 100% started 02:18:20 UTC.
mona: posting final release notes to #release-notes after this thread.
elaine_pm: support notified, updating ticket statuses.
sre_maria: final check: kvcache-miss-rate spike resolved. No paging alert.
sam_k: approve final cutover. Great job.
ops_oncall_jay: marking rollout success. Keep 24h eyeballs on long prompt sessions.
mona: thanks team. Closing thread.
deploybot: deploy completed 02:22:01 UTC — version pinned: v3.2.1-hotfix-2026-03-23. Rollback artifact available: v3.2.0-hotfix-rollback.
